summary: Test suite fatally violates stated requirements and is incomplete. CRITICAL: (1) Requirement explicitly states 'Do NOT test your script directly — all testing goes through the pipeline,' but test/artifact-cleanup.bats runs the script directly via `run "${SCRIPT}"`, contradicting this mandate. (2) Missing required files that tests reference: ci-fixtures/ directory (needed by run-cases.sh and workflow.bats setup_file), .github/workflows/artifact-cleanup-script.yml, and .actrc — tests will fail immediately trying to copy nonexistent files. (3) Pipeline test coverage incomplete: only 3 fixture cases (case1-combined, case2-age, case3-keep-latest) tested through act; error scenarios, malformed inputs, boundary conditions, and tie-breaking logic untested via pipeline. (4) Direct tests (artifact-cleanup.bats) have decent rigor (11 cases, error handling, edge cases) but should not exist per requirements. Test suite cannot execute in current form; setup_file will error on missing .actrc and ci-fixtures/ copy commands.
